question: In January 2025, the BLS Employment Situation report for December 2024 showed what change in total nonfarm payroll employment, as initially reported?
source_title: The Employment Situation - December 2024 (BLS, released Jan 10, 2025)
evidence: "Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 256,000 in December, and the unemployment rate changed little at 4.1 percent"

question: At its January 2025 meeting, the Bank of Japan set its short-term policy interest rate at what level?
source_title: Bank of Japan raises interest rates to highest level since 2008 at 0.5% (Business Standard)
evidence: On Jan 24, 2025 the BoJ board voted 8-1 to raise the policy rate by 25 bp to 0.5%, the highest in 17 years; Toyoaki Nakamura dissented.

question: In January 2025, Constellation Energy announced an agreement to acquire which U.S. power producer in a cash-and-stock deal with an equity purchase price of about $16.4 billion?
source_title: Constellation to Acquire Calpine, Creates America's Leading Producer of Clean and Reliable Energy (Constellation press release)
evidence: Jan 10, 2025: Constellation to acquire Calpine for an equity purchase price of about $16.4 billion (cash and stock); net purchase price $26.6 billion.

question: In January 2025, Johnson & Johnson agreed to acquire which neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company for $132 per share in cash (about $14.6 billion)?
source_title: Johnson & Johnson to Acquire Intra-Cellular Therapies for $14.6 Billion (InsideArbitrage)
evidence: Johnson & Johnson entered a merger agreement on January 13, 2025 to acquire Intra-Cellular Therapies for $132.00 per share in cash, an all-cash deal valued at $14.6 billion (also DCAT Value Chain Insights).

question: In January 2025, OpenAI, SoftBank and Oracle announced the 'Stargate' AI infrastructure venture at the White House. Up to how much did they say would be invested over the next four years?
source_title: Trump announces AI infrastructure investment backed by Oracle, OpenAI and SoftBank (NBC News)
evidence: Executives committed to invest an initial $100 billion and up to $500 billion over the next four years in Stargate, announced Jan 21, 2025.

question: Who won the women's singles title at the Australian Open in January 2025?
source_title: Madison Keys Australian Open 2025 winner (NBC Sports)
evidence: Madison Keys beat two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka 6-3, 2-6, 7-5 in the Jan 25, 2025 final for her first Grand Slam title.

question: Which team won the College Football Playoff national championship game played in January 2025?
source_title: Football post-game story: National Championship (Ohio State Athletics)
evidence: Ohio State beat Notre Dame 34-23 in the CFP national championship game in Atlanta on Jan 20, 2025.

question: Which film won Best Motion Picture - Drama at the Golden Globe Awards held in January 2025?
source_title: Here are the winners of the 2025 Golden Globes (NPR)
evidence: At the Jan 5, 2025 Golden Globes, The Brutalist won best motion picture, drama (nominees included A Complete Unknown, Conclave, Dune: Part Two, Nickel Boys, September 5).
